   261→// Save saves data column sidecars into the database and asynchronously performs pruning.
   262→// The returned channel is closed when the pruning is complete.
   263→func (dcs *DataColumnStorage) Save(dataColumnSidecars []blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn) error {
   264→	startTime := time.Now()
   265→
   266→	if len(dataColumnSidecars) == 0 {
   267→		return nil
   268→	}
   269→
   270→	// Check the number of columns is the one expected.
   271→	// While implementing this, we expect the number of columns won't change.
   272→	// If it does, we will need to create a new version of the data column sidecar file.
   273→	if params.BeaconConfig().NumberOfColumns != mandatoryNumberOfColumns {
   274→		return errWrongNumberOfColumns
   275→	}
   276→
   277→	dataColumnSidecarsByRoot := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn)
   278→
   279→	// Group data column sidecars by root.
   280→	for _, dataColumnSidecar := range dataColumnSidecars {
   281→		// Check if the data column index is too large.
   282→		if dataColumnSidecar.Index >= mandatoryNumberOfColumns {
   283→			return errDataColumnIndexTooLarge
   284→		}
   285→
   286→		// Group data column sidecars by root.
   287→		root := dataColumnSidecar.BlockRoot()
   288→		dataColumnSidecarsByRoot[root] = append(dataColumnSidecarsByRoot[root], dataColumnSidecar)
   289→	}
   290→
   291→	for root, dataColumnSidecars := range dataColumnSidecarsByRoot {
   292→		// Safety check all data column sidecars for this root are from the same slot.
   293→		slot := dataColumnSidecars[0].Slot()
   294→		for _, dataColumnSidecar := range dataColumnSidecars[1:] {
   295→			if dataColumnSidecar.Slot() != slot {
   296→				return errDataColumnSidecarsFromDifferentSlots
   297→			}
   298→		}
   299→
   300→		// Save data columns in the filesystem.
   301→		epoch := slots.ToEpoch(slot)
   302→		if err := dcs.saveFilesystem(root, epoch, dataColumnSidecars); err != nil {
   303→			return errors.Wrap(err, "save filesystem")
   304→		}
   305→
   306→		// Get all indices.
   307→		indices := make([]uint64, 0, len(dataColumnSidecars))
   308→		for _, dataColumnSidecar := range dataColumnSidecars {
   309→			indices = append(indices, dataColumnSidecar.Index)
   310→		}
   311→
   312→		// Compute the data columns ident.
   313→		dataColumnsIdent := DataColumnsIdent{Root: root, Epoch: epoch, Indices: indices}
   314→
   315→		// Set data columns in the cache.
   316→		if err := dcs.cache.set(dataColumnsIdent); err != nil {
   317→			return errors.Wrap(err, "cache set")
   318→		}
   319→
   320→		// Notify the data column feed.
   321→		dcs.dataColumnFeed.Send(dataColumnsIdent)
   322→	}
   323→
   324→	dataColumnSaveLatency.Observe(float64(time.Since(startTime).Milliseconds()))
   325→
   326→	return nil
   327→}

   382→// Get retrieves data column sidecars from the database.
   383→// If one of the requested data column sidecars is not found, it is just skipped.
   384→// If indices is nil, then all stored data column sidecars are returned.
   385→// Since DataColumnStorage only writes data columns that have undergone full verification, the return
   386→// value is always a VerifiedRODataColumn.
   387→func (dcs *DataColumnStorage) Get(root [fieldparams.RootLength]byte, indices []uint64) ([]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, error) {
   388→	dcs.pruneMu.RLock()
   389→	defer dcs.pruneMu.RUnlock()
   390→
   391→	fileMu, _ := dcs.fileMutexChan(root)
   392→	fileMu.RLock()
   393→	defer fileMu.RUnlock()
   394→
   395→	startTime := time.Now()
   396→
   397→	// Build all indices if none are provided.
   398→	if indices == nil {
   399→		indices = make([]uint64, mandatoryNumberOfColumns)
   400→		for i := range indices {
   401→			indices[i] = uint64(i)
   402→		}
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	summary, ok := dcs.cache.get(root)
   406→	if !ok {
   407→		// Nothing found in db. Exit early.
   408→		return nil, nil
   409→	}
   410→
   411→	// Exit early if no data column sidecars for this root is stored.
   412→	if !summary.HasAtLeastOneIndex(indices) {
   413→		return nil, nil
   414→	}
   415→
   416→	// Compute the file path.
   417→	filePath := filePath(root, summary.epoch)
   418→
   419→	// Open the data column sidecars file.
   420→	// We do not specially check if the file exists since we have already checked the cache.
   421→	file, err := dcs.fs.Open(filePath)
   422→	if err != nil {
   423→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "data column sidecars file path open")
   424→	}
   425→
   426→	// Read file metadata.
   427→	metadata, err := dcs.metadata(file)
   428→	if err != nil {
   429→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "metadata")
   430→	}
   431→
   432→	// Retrieve data column sidecars from the file.
   433→	verifiedRODataColumnSidecars := make([]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, 0, len(indices))
   434→	for _, index := range indices {
   435→		ok, position, err := metadata.indices.get(index)
   436→		if err != nil {
   437→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "get index")
   438→		}
   439→
   440→		// Skip if the data column is not saved.
   441→		if !ok {
   442→			continue
   443→		}
   444→
   445→		// Compute the offset of the data column sidecar.
   446→		offset := headerSize + position*int64(metadata.sszEncodedDataColumnSidecarSize)
   447→
   448→		// Seek to the beginning of the data column sidecar.
   449→		_, err = file.Seek(offset, io.SeekStart)
   450→		if err != nil {
   451→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "seek")
   452→		}
   453→
   454→		verifiedRODataColumn, err := verification.VerifiedRODataColumnFromDisk(file, root, metadata.sszEncodedDataColumnSidecarSize)
   455→		if err != nil {
   456→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "verified RO data column from disk")
   457→		}
   458→
   459→		// Append the verified RO data column to the data column sidecars.
   460→		verifiedRODataColumnSidecars = append(verifiedRODataColumnSidecars, verifiedRODataColumn)
   461→	}
   462→
   463→	dataColumnFetchLatency.Observe(float64(time.Since(startTime).Milliseconds()))
   464→
   465→	return verifiedRODataColumnSidecars, nil
   466→}

   516→// prune clean the cache, the filesystem and mutexes.
   517→func (dcs *DataColumnStorage) prune() {
   518→	highestStoredEpoch := dcs.cache.HighestEpoch()
   519→
   520→	// Check if we need to prune.
   521→	if highestStoredEpoch < dcs.retentionEpochs {
   522→		return
   523→	}
   524→
   525→	highestEpochToPrune := highestStoredEpoch - dcs.retentionEpochs
   526→	highestPeriodToPrune := period(highestEpochToPrune)
   527→
   528→	// Prune the cache.
   529→	prunedCount := dcs.cache.pruneUpTo(highestEpochToPrune)
   530→
   531→	if prunedCount == 0 {
   532→		return
   533→	}
   534→
   535→	dataColumnPrunedCounter.Add(float64(prunedCount))
   536→
   537→	// Prune the filesystem.
   538→	periodFileInfos, err := afero.ReadDir(dcs.fs, ".")
   539→	if err != nil {
   540→		log.WithError(err).Error("Error encountered while reading top directory")
   541→		return
   542→	}
   543→
   544→	for _, periodFileInfo := range periodFileInfos {
   545→		periodStr := periodFileInfo.Name()
   546→		period, err := strconv.ParseUint(periodStr, 10, 64)
   547→		if err != nil {
   548→			log.WithError(err).Errorf("Error encountered while parsing period %s", periodStr)
   549→			continue
   550→		}
   551→
   552→		if period < highestPeriodToPrune {
   553→			// Remove everything lower thant highest period to prune.
   554→			if err := dcs.fs.RemoveAll(periodStr); err != nil {
   555→				log.WithError(err).Error("Error encountered while removing period directory")
   556→			}
   557→
   558→			continue
   559→		}
   560→
   561→		if period > highestPeriodToPrune {
   562→			// Do not remove anything higher than highest period to prune.
   563→			continue
   564→		}
   565→
   566→		// if period == highestPeriodToPrune
   567→		epochFileInfos, err := afero.ReadDir(dcs.fs, periodStr)
   568→		if err != nil {
   569→			log.WithError(err).Error("Error encountered while reading epoch directory")
   570→			continue
   571→		}
   572→
   573→		for _, epochFileInfo := range epochFileInfos {
   574→			epochStr := epochFileInfo.Name()
   575→			epochDir := path.Join(periodStr, epochStr)
   576→
   577→			epoch, err := strconv.ParseUint(epochStr, 10, 64)
   578→			if err != nil {
   579→				log.WithError(err).Errorf("Error encountered while parsing epoch %s", epochStr)
   580→				continue
   581→			}
   582→
   583→			if primitives.Epoch(epoch) > highestEpochToPrune {
   584→				continue
   585→			}
   586→
   587→			if err := dcs.fs.RemoveAll(epochDir); err != nil {
   588→				log.WithError(err).Error("Error encountered while removing epoch directory")
   589→				continue
   590→			}
   591→		}
   592→	}
   593→
   594→	dcs.mu.Lock()
   595→	defer dcs.mu.Unlock()
   596→	clear(dcs.muChans)
   597→}

   599→// saveDataColumnSidecarsExistingFile saves data column sidecars into an existing file.
   600→// This function expects all data column sidecars to belong to the same block.
   601→func (dcs *DataColumnStorage) saveDataColumnSidecarsExistingFile(filePath string, inputDataColumnSidecars chan []blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn) (err error) {
   602→	// Open the data column sidecars file.
   603→	file, err := dcs.fs.OpenFile(filePath, os.O_RDWR, os.FileMode(0600))
   604→	if err != nil {
   605→		return errors.Wrap(err, "data column sidecars file path open")
   606→	}
   607→
   608→	defer func() {
   609→		closeErr := file.Close()
   610→
   611→		// Overwrite the existing error only if it is nil, since the close error is less important.
   612→		if closeErr != nil && err == nil {
   613→			err = closeErr
   614→		}
   615→	}()
   616→
   617→	metadata, err := dcs.metadata(file)
   618→	if err != nil {
   619→		return errors.Wrap(err, "metadata")
   620→	}
   621→
   622→	// Create the SSZ encoded data column sidecars.
   623→	var sszEncodedDataColumnSidecars []byte
   624→
   625→	for {
   626→		dataColumnSidecars := pullChan(inputDataColumnSidecars)
   627→		if len(dataColumnSidecars) == 0 {
   628→			break
   629→		}
   630→
   631→		for _, dataColumnSidecar := range dataColumnSidecars {
   632→			// Extract the data columns index.
   633→			dataColumnIndex := dataColumnSidecar.Index
   634→
   635→			ok, _, err := metadata.indices.get(dataColumnIndex)
   636→			if err != nil {
   637→				return errors.Wrap(err, "get index")
   638→			}
   639→
   640→			// Skip if the data column is already saved.
   641→			if ok {
   642→				continue
   643→			}
   644→
   645→			// Check if the number of saved data columns is too large.
   646→			// This is impossible to happen in practice is this function is called
   647→			// by SaveDataColumnSidecars.
   648→			if metadata.indices.len() >= mandatoryNumberOfColumns {
   649→				return errTooManyDataColumns
   650→			}
   651→
   652→			// SSZ encode the data column sidecar.
   653→			sszEncodedDataColumnSidecar, err := dataColumnSidecar.MarshalSSZ()
   654→			if err != nil {
   655→				return errors.Wrap(err, "data column sidecar marshal SSZ")
   656→			}
   657→
   658→			// Compute the size of the SSZ encoded data column sidecar.
   659→			incomingSszEncodedDataColumnSidecarSize := uint32(len(sszEncodedDataColumnSidecar))
   660→
   661→			// Check if the incoming encoded data column sidecar size corresponds to the one read from the file.
   662→			if incomingSszEncodedDataColumnSidecarSize != metadata.sszEncodedDataColumnSidecarSize {
   663→				return errWrongSszEncodedDataColumnSidecarSize
   664→			}
   665→
   666→			// Alter indices to mark the data column as saved.
   667→			if err := metadata.indices.set(dataColumnIndex, uint8(metadata.indices.len())); err != nil {
   668→				return errors.Wrap(err, "set index")
   669→			}
   670→
   671→			// Append the SSZ encoded data column sidecar to the SSZ encoded data column sidecars.
   672→			sszEncodedDataColumnSidecars = append(sszEncodedDataColumnSidecars, sszEncodedDataColumnSidecar...)
   673→		}
   674→	}
   675→
   676→	// Save indices to the file.
   677→	indices := metadata.indices.raw()
   678→	count, err := file.WriteAt(indices[:], int64(versionSize+sidecarByteLenSize))
   679→	if err != nil {
   680→		return errors.Wrap(err, "write indices")
   681→	}
   682→	if count != mandatoryNumberOfColumns {
   683→		return errWrongBytesWritten
   684→	}
   685→
   686→	// Append the SSZ encoded data column sidecars to the end of the file.
   687→	count, err = file.WriteAt(sszEncodedDataColumnSidecars, metadata.fileSize)
   688→	if err != nil {
   689→		return errors.Wrap(err, "write SSZ encoded data column sidecars")
   690→	}
   691→	if count != len(sszEncodedDataColumnSidecars) {
   692→		return errWrongBytesWritten
   693→	}
   694→
   695→	if err := file.Sync(); err != nil {
   696→		return errors.Wrap(err, "sync")
   697→	}
   698→
   699→	return nil
   700→}

   702→// saveDataColumnSidecarsNewFile saves data column sidecars into a new file.
   703→// This function expects all data column sidecars to belong to the same block.
   704→func (dcs *DataColumnStorage) saveDataColumnSidecarsNewFile(filePath string, inputDataColumnSidecars chan []blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn) (err error) {
   705→	// Initialize the indices.
   706→	var indices storageIndices
   707→
   708→	var (
   709→		sszEncodedDataColumnSidecarRefSize int
   710→		sszEncodedDataColumnSidecars       []byte
   711→	)
   712→
   713→	// Initialize the count of the saved SSZ encoded data column sidecar.
   714→	storedCount := uint8(0)
   715→
   716→	for {
   717→		dataColumnSidecars := pullChan(inputDataColumnSidecars)
   718→		if len(dataColumnSidecars) == 0 {
   719→			break
   720→		}
   721→
   722→		for _, dataColumnSidecar := range dataColumnSidecars {
   723→			// Extract the data column index.
   724→			dataColumnIndex := dataColumnSidecar.Index
   725→
   726→			// Skip if the data column is already stored.
   727→			ok, _, err := indices.get(dataColumnIndex)
   728→			if err != nil {
   729→				return errors.Wrap(err, "get index")
   730→			}
   731→			if ok {
   732→				continue
   733→			}
   734→
   735→			// Alter the indices to mark the first data column sidecar as saved.
   736→			// savedCount can safely be cast to uint8 since it is less than limit.
   737→			if err := indices.set(dataColumnIndex, storedCount); err != nil {
   738→				return errors.Wrap(err, "set index")
   739→			}
   740→
   741→			// Increment the count of the saved SSZ encoded data column sidecar.
   742→			storedCount++
   743→
   744→			// SSZ encode the first data column sidecar.
   745→			sszEncodedDataColumnSidecar, err := dataColumnSidecar.MarshalSSZ()
   746→			if err != nil {
   747→				return errors.Wrap(err, "data column sidecar marshal SSZ")
   748→			}
   749→
   750→			// Check if the size of the SSZ encoded data column sidecar is correct.
   751→			if sszEncodedDataColumnSidecarRefSize != 0 && len(sszEncodedDataColumnSidecar) != sszEncodedDataColumnSidecarRefSize {
   752→				return errWrongSszEncodedDataColumnSidecarSize
   753→			}
   754→
   755→			// Set the SSZ encoded data column sidecar reference size.
   756→			sszEncodedDataColumnSidecarRefSize = len(sszEncodedDataColumnSidecar)
   757→
   758→			// Append the first SSZ encoded data column sidecar to the SSZ encoded data column sidecars.
   759→			sszEncodedDataColumnSidecars = append(sszEncodedDataColumnSidecars, sszEncodedDataColumnSidecar...)
   760→		}
   761→	}
   762→
   763→	if storedCount == 0 {
   764→		// Nothing to save.
   765→		return nil
   766→	}
   767→
   768→	// Create the data column sidecars file.
   769→	dir := filepath.Dir(filePath)
   770→	if err := dcs.fs.MkdirAll(dir, directoryPermissions()); err != nil {
   771→		return errors.Wrapf(err, "mkdir all")
   772→	}
   773→
   774→	file, err := dcs.fs.Create(filePath)
   775→	if err != nil {
   776→		return errors.Wrap(err, "data column sidecars file path create")
   777→	}
   778→
   779→	defer func() {
   780→		closeErr := file.Close()
   781→
   782→		// Overwrite the existing error only if it is nil, since the close error is less important.
   783→		if closeErr != nil && err == nil {
   784→			err = closeErr
   785→		}
   786→	}()
   787→
   788→	// Encode the SSZ encoded data column sidecar size.
   789→	var encodedSszEncodedDataColumnSidecarSize [sidecarByteLenSize]byte
   790→	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(encodedSszEncodedDataColumnSidecarSize[:], uint32(sszEncodedDataColumnSidecarRefSize))
   791→
   792→	// Get the raw indices.
   793→	rawIndices := indices.raw()
   794→
   795→	// Concatenate the version, the data column sidecar size, the data column indices and the SSZ encoded data column sidecar.
   796→	countToWrite := headerSize + len(sszEncodedDataColumnSidecars)

   993→	parts := strings.Split(path, "/")
   994→	if len(parts) != 3 {
   995→		return nil, errors.Errorf("unexpected file %s", path)

   997→
   998→	period, err := strconv.ParseUint(parts[0], 10, 64)

  1001→	}
  1002→

  1011→	}
  1012→

  1017→

  1020→	}

  1022→	blockRootSlice, err := hex.DecodeString(blockRootString[2:])
  1023→	if err != nil {
  1024→		return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "decode string from %s", path)
  1025→	}
  1026→
  1027→	var blockRoot [fieldparams.RootLength]byte
  1028→	copy(blockRoot[:], blockRootSlice)
